passages.title: Notice 1
passages.text: ATTENTION PASSENGERS: Due to a technical fault with the signalling system, all trains departing from Platform 4 are delayed by at least 30 minutes. Please check the information screens for updates.

passages.title: Notice 2
passages.text: AIRPORT SHUTTLE: Passengers requiring transport to Terminal 3 should purchase tickets at the kiosk inside the main hall before boarding the bus. Drivers cannot accept cash payments.

passages.title: Notice 3
passages.text: LOST PROPERTY: Any items found on the train or at the station must be handed in to the Customer Service desk. Please provide a description of the item if you are reporting a loss.

passages.title: Notice 4
passages.text: UNATTENDED LUGGAGE: For security reasons, do not leave bags unattended at any time. Any luggage left alone will be removed and destroyed by security staff immediately.

passages.title: Notice 5
passages.text: PLATFORM MAINTENANCE: Work is currently being carried out on the roof of Platform 2. Please follow the yellow signs and use the alternative staircase located near the exit.

questions.question: What should passengers do if their train is from Platform 4?
questions.explanation: The notice advises passengers to check the screens for updates because of a delay.
options: b) Look at the screens for new information.
c) Go to a different platform.

questions.question: How can you pay for the airport shuttle?
questions.explanation: The text says drivers cannot accept cash, so you must buy a ticket at the kiosk.
options: a) By buying a ticket at the kiosk.
b) By paying when you arrive at the terminal.
c) By paying the driver cash.

questions.question: What should you do if you lose something at the station?
questions.explanation: The notice instructs people to report the loss at the Customer Service desk.
options: a) Tell the Customer Service staff.
b) Look for it on the train yourself.
c) Wait for someone to find it.

questions.question: What happens to bags left alone?
questions.explanation: The notice states they will be removed and destroyed.
options: a) They are kept in a safe place.
b) They are taken to the police station.
c) They are taken away and destroyed.

questions.question: How should passengers get to the exit?
questions.explanation: The notice says to follow the yellow signs and use the alternative staircase.
options: a) Use the main stairs as usual.
b) Follow the signs to a different staircase.
c) Wait for the maintenance work to finish.
